description: LinkedIn jobs search API for AI agents: send a job title or keywords and an optional location and get up to 50 public job listings as JSON: title, company, location, posting date, employment type, seniority, salary when listed, the listing's URL and its description. Filter by how recently a job was posted. Recruiter names are not returned. Jobs you paid for but did not get are refunded.

limit.description: number of jobs wanted, 1 to 50 (default 10). A larger value is lowered to 50 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

location.description: city, region or country, e.g. "Prague" (default: anywhere)

posted.description: only jobs posted within the last day (24h), week or month (default: any time)

query.description: job title, skill or company, e.g. "data engineer"

name: linkedin-jobs
title: LinkedIn job listings for a search
